name: Sakana Namazu
title: Sakana Namazu: price, context window and specs
answer: Sakana Namazu is a model from Sakana, first listed on 2026-08-11. It is the only version of its line in the catalog so far. It takes text, image and file in and returns text, with a context window of 262K tokens and up to 65K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.95 per million input tokens and $4 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
